AGENDA
  GLENDALE CITY COUNCIL
  COUNCIL CHAMBER, City Hall – 613 E Broadway, 2nd Floor
  Glendale, CA 91206
Welcome to Glendale City Hall. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and rebroadcast
throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for
purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at
http://www.glendaleca.gov/government/agendas-minutes. If you have any question about matters on the
agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business
hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBER.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign language
translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices are available same-day
upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for requests regarding sign language
translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related to open session items on this agenda that
are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the
Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who wish to utilize
the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City Clerk’s office at 818-548-
2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify the language for which you require
translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not required and persons are welcome to use their
own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  JANUARY 15, 2019
  ROLL CALL
  1. CLOSED SESSION – 1:00 p.m. (To Commence at 3:00 p.m.)
  a. Conference with Legal Counsel, Pending Litigation: Saavedra et al. v. City of
  Glendale, Court of Appeal Case No. B281991; Glendale Coalition for Better Gov't v.
  City of Glendale, Court of Appeal Case No. B281994; Glendale Coalition for Better
  Gov't v. City of Glendale, Court of Appeal Case No. B282410; Glendale Coalition
  for Better Gov't v. City of Glendale, L.A. Superior Court Case No. BS174485.

  2. REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 6:00 p.m.
  Roll Call
  a. Flag Salute: Council Member Agajanian
  b. Invocation: Pastor John Aitken II, Living Stones Seventh-day Adventist Church
  (La Crescenta)
  c. Report of City Clerk, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the January 15, 2019
  Regular Meeting of the Glendale City Council was Posted on Friday, January 11,
  2019, on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.

  3. PRESENTATIONS AND APPOINTMENTS
  a. Agenda Preview for the Meetings of Tuesday, January 22, 2019
  b. Proclamation Designating January 13, 2019 as the 16th Anniversary of Korean

 4. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are Routine and May be Acted Upon by One Motion. Any Member of Council
  or the Audience Requesting Separate Consideration May do so by Making Such Request
  Before Motion is Proposed.
  a. Minutes of the Special City Council Meeting of December 18, 2018 and Regular
  City Council Meetings of December 11, 2018 and December 18, 2018
  b. Public Works, re: Approval of the Final Map of Tract No. 73874, for a 4-unit
  Condominium Subdivision, at 115 N. Adams Street
  1. Resolution Approving the Final Map of Tract No. 73874
  c. Public Works, re: Downtown Glendale Internally Illuminated Street Name Sign
  Replacement Project Phase 3
  1. Motion Awarding a Construction Contract to Vart Construction, Inc. in the Amount of
  $375,509, Approving a 15% Reserve for Contingencies, Rejecting All Other Bids; and
  Authorizing the City Manager to Execute the Contract
  d. General Manager of Glendale Water & Power, re: Summary Vacation of the City of
  Glendale’s Electrical Easements on the Properties Located at 1619 Gladys Drive
  and Unaddressed Lot Located on Luring Drive
  1. Resolution Ordering the Summary Vacation of the City of Glendale’s Electrical
  Easements on the Properties Located at 1619 Gladys Drive and Unaddressed Lot
  Located on Luring Drive (APN: 5665-015-008 & 010)
  e. Director of Community Development, re: Release of a Request for Proposals (RFP)
  to Develop City Owned Property Located at 233 N. Maryland Avenue (City Parking
  Lot #3) and 303 N. Maryland Avenue (City Parking Lot #2)
  1. Motion Directing Staff to Release a RFP for a Boutique Hotel Development for City
  Parking Lots #2 and #3
  f. City Attorney, re: Consideration of Contract Increase for ABI Document Support
  Services
  1. Motion Authorizing the Increase of the Contract between the City of Glendale and ABI
  Document Support Services
  g. Director of Community Services and Parks, re: Award of Additional Funding from
  County of Los Angeles Workforce Development, Aging, and Community Services
  (WDACS) Elderly Nutrition Program (ENP) Amendment Three Contract for FY
  2018-2019
  1. Motion Authorizing the City Manager to Accept and Execute Amendment Three with
  the County Of Los Angeles WDACS Accepting Additional $23,000 for the ENP
  Contract for FY 2018-2019 for the Term of November 1, 2018 through June 30, 2019
  2. Resolution Appropriating $23,000
